build: Write a new Branch C# tool; this is a brand-new tool, not a revision. Rearrange this roof into the Leaf Automation logo: move every solar panel (the Module block references on layer _CE MODULES; Branch panel groups also list them in the LEAF-PANELGROUP Xrecord's PanelHandlesList) so together they form the logo, each panel travelling along a counter-clockwise spiral around the array's centre, twisting more the farther out it starts. The logo is six pointed-oval leaves in a unit circle: leaf A centre (-0.34, -0.25), long axis 165 degrees, length 1.14, width 0.28; leaf B centre (-0.56, 0.34), long axis 46 degrees, length 1.25, width 0.28; copy A and B rotated 120 and 240 degrees about the centre. Fill each leaf with panel-sized slots on a grid along its long axis with no overlaps, scale the logo just big enough to hold every panel, and rotate it by the panels' own rotation so it reads upright. Keep each panel's block and size: only move and rotate it with TransformBy. Draw a thin spiral trail for every sixth panel on a new layer LEAF-MORPH-TRAILS, set the panel layer colour to RGB 40, 214, 111, and return the number of panels moved. Call the new tool leaf-morph.
